dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Nara friend! Everybody said you have a big "backpack," and Aranara need lots of "materials" for Vanarana. Can you help, Nara Friend?

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: A lot of materials refers to lots of mushrooms! <color=#00E1FFFF>Normal Starshrooms, lethargic Starshrooms, lively Starshrooms</color>, need them all...

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Three kinds of Starshrooms</color> is a lot, but "very useful"?

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Golden Nara delivers! Golden Nara has a great "backpack" with everything possible inside! Thank you, good Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: I'm going back to Vanarana now. Bye, good Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that one of the little fairies from before?
